core_obligations: Recursively remove an outgoing arc of the maximal vertex and retain sufficient generators for the smaller quiver.
Choose extremal common accessible vertices and add one path-pair relation for each.
Factor every remaining pair of parallel paths through a chosen common descendant to prove the generated path relation is full.
difficulty_reason: The construction synthesizes a finite set of local commutativity obligations that force all parallel paths in an acyclic diagram to agree. The author combines reverse topological recursion, common-accessibility frontiers and a congruence-factorization argument. This is the main commutativity-generator algorithm, not a textbook category lemma or a claim that the generator set is minimal.
